name: str_equal
title: Determine if two strings are equivalent

origin.description: Compare two character vectors with Unicode collation, and optionally ignore case.

arguments.name: x, y
arguments.text: A pair of character vectors. A length-1 vector is recycled. Any other two lengths must agree.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en" so English collation is the same on every platform.

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: TRUE compares at secondary strength. A supplied strength replaces that choice.
Further collator settings, passed through str_opts_collator to stringi::stri_opts_collator().

origin.details: The size check is vctrs::vec_size_common. Incompatible sizes stop with a recycle error before the collator runs. Equivalence uses canonical equivalence, so a-acute in one code point matches a plus a combining acute, and ohm matches omega. A missing element makes that result missing. The default locale is English.
origin.value: A logical vector. NA where either side is missing. An empty argument gives logical(0).

translation.description: Compare two character vectors with Unicode collation, and optionally ignore case.

arguments.name: x, y
arguments.text: A string, NA, a number, None, or a list of those. A length-1 value recycles. None does not set the size.

arguments.name: locale
arguments.text: Locale used for comparisons. The default is "en".

arguments.name: ignore_case
arguments.text: True compares at secondary strength. A supplied strength replaces that choice.

arguments.name: kwargs
arguments.text: Further settings passed to stri_opts_collator, including strength and numeric.

translation.details: The size check is stringr._size.size_common, the vctrs rule. The comparison is stri_cmp_equiv. A leading U+FEFF is ignored by that comparison. The default locale is English. Results are lists. NA is stringi._na.NA.
translation.value: A list of True, False, or NA. An empty argument is an empty list.
